additional_practice.prompt: A pure substance melts at constant pressure. Which statement is correct? Choose one: A its particles become larger; B its internal energy increases while its temperature stays constant; C its mass increases; D its average particle kinetic energy must increase.
additional_practice.answer: B: its internal energy increases while its temperature stays constant.

additional_practice.prompt:
A student slowly compresses a fixed mass of gas and records the results below. Use calculations to test whether the results support pV = constant. Explain why the gas must be allowed to return to room temperature between readings.

| Volume (cm³) | Pressure (kPa) |
|---|---|
| 60 | 100 |
| 40 | 150 |
| 30 | 200 |
additional_practice.answer:
- The products are 60 × 100 = **6000**, 40 × 150 = **6000**, and 30 × 200 = **6000 kPa cm³**.
- The equal products support **pV = constant** for these measurements.
- Compression can do work on the gas and raise its temperature.
- Waiting lets it return to the same temperature, so changes in temperature do not affect the pressure comparison.

additional_practice.prompt: A 250 W heater melts 150 g of ice initially at 0°C and then warms the water to 25°C. Assume no energy is lost. Use L = 334 000 J/kg and c = 4200 J/kg°C. Calculate the total energy required and the heating time.
